title: gamemenuframe
summary: MSUI retains its complete build-5875 Game Menu and logout presentation. Escape now follows the frozen special-rung order with one consumer per edge, the Main Menu micro seat truly opens/closes through the modal, center ownership displaces existing panels and gates new routed opens, logout dialogs emit one Open/Close cue per visibility edge, and observational capture reports actual rendered state without staging. Connected visual/audio/input/wire proof remains outstanding.

openItems.text: MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). MSUI's complete existing game-menu composition is preserved; only missing behavior was added, and Benilla's different Era ladder did not replace present MSUI controls.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI's live menu destinations now play the exact main-menu sound kits while retaining their existing navigation.
